### What is wrong

One or two sentences. What the software did that it should not have done, or did
not do that it should have.

### What you expected instead

Say what the correct behaviour would have been, so a reader can tell a defect
from a disagreement about the design.

### The smallest reproduction

Cut it down until removing one more step makes it stop happening. Paste the
commands and their output rather than describing them.

```
```

### Version

The release tag, or the commit if you are running from source.

### Deployment shape

Where it runs, what it stores subjects on, whether the model is switched on, and
anything you changed from the defaults. A defect that only appears under one
configuration is a different defect from one that appears under all of them.

### Anything you already ruled out

Optional. If you checked something and it was not the cause, say so. It saves the
same check being run again.
